{{Quote|The Empire has patrols all through the mountains now, thick as the yarrowfew flowers in spring.|Dona Telamark|<ref name="Secret weapon" />}}
A '''yarrowfew flower''' was a type of [[Flower/Legends|flower]].<ref name="Secret weapon" /> Around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]],<ref name="Dates">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The Last of the Jedi: Secret Weapon]]'' to around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]].</ref> while on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Omman Minor|Omman]], members of [[the Eleven]]&mdash;a resistance group based on the planet [[Bellassa/Legends|Bellassa]]&mdash;planned a way into Bellassa's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] [[Ussa]].<ref name="Secret weapon" /> The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]]<ref name="Reckoning">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Reckoning]]''</ref> [[Eve Yarrow|Flame]] suggested landing in the world's [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] and taking [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]] to Ussa. Resistance member [[Dona Telamark]] responded by explaining that the route would not work due to the thickness of Imperial patrols in the mountains, which she compared to that of yarrowfew flowers in [[Spring/Legends|spring]].<ref name="Secret weapon" />

==Behind the scenes==
Yarrofew flowers were mentioned in ''[[The Last of the Jedi: Secret Weapon]]'', a [[2007]] junior novel written by [[Jude Watson]] as the seventh installment in the ''[[Star Wars: The Last of the Jedi]]'' series.<ref name="Secret weapon" />
